svg.title: Adding the legs of a bull call spread
svg.desc: Three small payoff diagrams. A long 100 call bought for 4.45 loses 4.45 below 100 and rises after it. A short 105 call sold for 2.40 earns 2.40 below 105 and falls after it. Added price by price they make a bull call spread: a loss of 2.05 below 100, a rise between 100 and 105 crossing zero at 102.05, and a flat profit of 2.95 above 105.

g.text: Underlying price at expiry. Each point of the spread is the sum of the two legs at that price.
